name: flyleaf
title: Flyleaf
description: A bookshop's pile of cloth-bound books seen spine-on: every product is a navy, oxblood or bottle-green spine of its own width, shoved a little off the one below, with its name stamped in pale-gold small capitals, its category in italic as the imprint and its price on a paper label.

tokens.--font-serif: the one old-style serif of the whole site: text, small-capital titles and italic
tokens.--font-mono: inline code and code blocks in page text
tokens.--tracking: letter spacing of everything set in small capitals: the shop's name, spine titles, card headings
tokens.--title-size: size of the title stamped on a spine in the pile; the product page scales its own up
tokens.--color-text: body text, headings, the shop's name and the heavy rules: the thick-and-thin rule under a heading, the rule over details, tables and the news list
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text: dates, the footer, page numbers, the empty-list line, the outline of the missing book on the 404 page
tokens.--color-accent: links, the underline of the current menu item and focus rings on the page ground
tokens.--color-line: thin rules: under the masthead, above the footer, between details, in tables and the news list, around a product photograph
tokens.--color-shelf: the shelf edge the pile rests on
tokens.--color-navy: the first of the three cloths: every third spine from the first, the spine on a product page, and the ground of selected text
tokens.--color-oxblood: the second cloth: every third spine from the second
tokens.--color-green: the third cloth: every third spine from the third
tokens.--color-foil: the foil stamping on a cloth spine: title, imprint, the head and tail bands, the focus ring; also selected text
tokens.--color-sheen: the light caught along the upper board edge of a spine
tokens.--color-shade: the hard shadow where a book overhangs the one below, the lower board edge of a spine, and the bite behind foil lettering and under a paper label
tokens.--color-label: paper: the price label, the status slips, the page block of a sold-out book, and the how-to-order card
tokens.--color-label-ink: everything written on that paper: prices, status words and their borders, a sold-out title, the how-to-order card with its ruled border and focus rings
tokens.--color-page-edge: the lines of the page edges on a sold-out book, which is turned fore-edge out
tokens.--color-code-bg: background of code in page text
tokens.--measure: maximum width of a column of text
tokens.--pile-play: how much narrower the narrowest book in the pile is than the full width; halved on phones
tokens.--overhang: depth of the shadow under an overhanging book, and the board thickness of a sold-out book
tokens.--shelf: thickness of the shelf edge under the pile
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of spines, the how-to-order card and code
tokens.--space-1: hairline gap: between a label and its value
tokens.--space-2: small gap: inside lists and rows
tokens.--space-3: page gutter on small screens, paragraph spacing, padding of the card
tokens.--space-5: large gap: between the two columns, above the how-to-order card, under the page
